grade_reason: His campaign issues page mentions artificial intelligence only as a field to invest in, and no statement since 1 January 2025 acknowledging catastrophic risk from AI was found.
notes: Six web searches ran; none was refused. The searches found no statement by Boafo on AI risk, superintelligence, extinction, a pause or slowdown, or China talks, and no source showing he co-sponsored the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act (he was not in Congress). Campaign site https://www.adrianboafo.com/issues (opened, undated) has a 'Technology & Innovation' section calling for investment in emerging technologies including artificial intelligence and for data centers that pay their fair share and use renewable energy; it does not mention AI risks, safety or regulation. No quote was recorded because the page fetch tool gave slightly inconsistent wording for that passage and the page is undated. A search-result snippet (not opened) says that as a Maryland delegate he co-sponsored HB0883 (2026 session), 'Consumer Protection - Artificial Intelligence - Behavioral Health Care Prohibitions' (https://www.mgaleg.maryland.gov/mgawebsite/Members/Details/boafo01?ys=2026RS), and that he was listed among sponsors of Maryland's Artificial Intelligence Governance Act of 2024 (before the period); both would be D-level and are not verified. His FOSI profile (https://fosi.org/?p=12639) says he is Senior Director of Government Affairs at Oracle; it does not mention AI. Several search results concerned unrelated people named Boafo in Ghana and were ignored.
